observations.content: Assistant's session ledger file is ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--home-coder-workspaces-learn--/2026-08-30T10-19-34-772Z_01a0522e-81f4-7311-8ba4-027cea97e974.jsonl; session 01a0522e started 2026-08-30T10:19:34.772Z in cwd /home/coder/workspaces/learn, model zaicp/glm-5.3 via cli-openai, thinking level high.
Ledger evidence: scout subagent called message_main at 10:23:37Z and got toolResult 'Main agent is busy — message queued, will be delivered when it goes idle.' (queued call_f0ac56fb...).
Ledger evidence: parent session had no CHANNEL_OK entry and no activity between ~10:43:16 and 10:56:23 (idle period), so no flush/delivery occurred while idle.

Ledger evidence: CHANNEL_OK appeared only inside user message entry [174] at 10:56:24.580Z, wrapped in a <subagent-message> block, ~33 minutes after being queued; user had to manually stop the session and send a new message.

User's prior assertion (Vietnamese): subagent message via message_main never got delivered; from Paseo UI parent session appeared to keep running without stopping and user had to manually stop it and send a new chat message for the queued message to show up.
Scout agent f5971b2f-52c2-478a-8c51-a22a5375feb9 (named 'Diagnose message_main queue flush') finished its investigation and delivered a report via paseo agent-response.

Root-cause files: /home/coder/workspaces/learn/.pi/extensions/subagent-types/paseo-channel.ts (lines 1-234, MCP loopback client plus sendToSubagent/sendToMain plus poll-based flushWhenIdle), /home/coder/workspaces/learn/.pi/extensions/subagent-types/index.ts (lines 343-360 lifecycle hooks, 568-594 message_main tool), paseo-spawn.ts (no idle/flush logic).
The 'Main agent is busy — message queued, will be delivered when it goes idle.' string is produced at index.ts:588 in message_main tool execute via ternary on r.delivered==='queued'.

message_main wraps body as <subagent-message from="${myAgentId}" role="${myRole ?? '?'}"> ${params.message} </subagent-message> (index.ts:585) before calling sendToMain, so the wrapper text becomes the daemon's prompt body.

Delivery mechanism: both paths use daemon MCP loopback tool send_agent_prompt; idle path (paseo-channel.ts:228-230) calls it immediately with background:true, notifyOnFinish:false; busy path (222-225, 232-234) pushes to module-level pendingToMain and schedules flushWhenIdle.

flushWhenIdle (paseo-channel.ts:182-215) is the ONLY drain path: self-rescheduling setTimeout polling get_agent_status every 5s (1s first tick, 15s on error); when status is not running/initializing it splices the batch and calls send_agent_prompt.

Confirmed by grep: extension registers zero listeners for agent_end, agent_settled, turn_end, turn_start, setInterval; index.ts:343-360 only registers session_start, input, and tool_call, and the input listener only calls applyRole and does not touch pendingToMain.

Doc comment on paseo-channel.ts:13-15 claiming 'flushed as a follow-up once the main agent goes idle (agent_end observed over status polling)' describes intent only; implementation is blind polling with no agent_end event listener.

Failure causes identified: get_agent_status returns stale 'running' indefinitely; pendingToMain[0].agentId is captured once at first tick so stale main agent id never self-corrects; flushTimer is a single-slot scheduler so a sendToMain during an in-flight tick never re-arms; no session_switch/shutdown listener means pendingToMain leaks across sessions.

Reason parent appears 'running' forever: the 5s get_agent_status polling loop itself is authenticated POST traffic to the daemon loopback that extends the parent's activity window, plus no native-idle fallback; manual stop + new message forced daemon to acknowledge idle so next poll succeeded.

Recommended fix: add pi.on('agent_settled') (not agent_end, which can fire multiple times per turn per docs/extensions.md:567-572); move flush into shared flushPending that atomically splices pendingToMain and sends send_agent_prompt with cached endpoint; cancel flushTimer on real idle; keep bounded backstop poll (max ~2 retries) only for daemon lag; hook input as secondary drain; add inFlight Promise guard to prevent double delivery; add session_switch cleanup clearing pendingToMain; rewrite misleading doc comment.
Assistant fetched scout activity twice (limit 5 then limit 2) via paseo_get_agent_activity because the agent-response was truncated; updateCount reached 370 by the second fetch.

OM observer ran throughout (run obs-20260830105940-1493876-6, ~19 obs, $0.0079 cumulative across 6 runs); user's /snip command armed snippets (Session kickoff, Ask questions, Delegate exploration, Diagnose) then deactivated them at 10:56:24.
